R3.reason: An additive explosion should read as fire: bright yellow, orange and red that fade toward dark. The frame is a neutral pale grey with no warm hue and no bright core, so the colour the brief asks for is absent.

R4.reason: It is one frame, so there is no burst, growth, billowing or burn-out. Against the explosion class, the measured envelope fails every check: peak at 0 (class 0.22 to 0.71), first 1 (class 0 to 0.22, an attack in its envelope), last 1 (class 0 to 0.03, it does not end dark). The frame is still at full brightness.

R5.reason: The file is type parallel and format additive, which matches the game's own type and format (gameType and gameFormat), keeps the name zerogxplode.spr, and reads back as written (sameName and readsBack true). The fit with the game is right, even though the content is not.
